title: Coffee Mate's Festive New Cold Foam Flavor Has Fans Divided: 'Major Seasonal Identity Crisis' - NewsBreak
text: Am I the only one who feels like time is moving in hyper speed and the seasons are coming in faster than we can keep up with? We still have a solid month of summer left, but judging by the inventory at grocery stores, it’s been fall for at least two weeks already. We get it, time is a construct—and it definitely feels like we’ve taken a few steps backward in time—but can we at least enjoy the last few days of summer before pumpkin spice takes over? It’s like someone flipped the switch too early, and now everyone is confused about what time of year it is. On the one hand, we understand getting into the spirit ahead of time, but on the other, it might be a bit too early to start putting out pumpkins and gourds as if the Great Pumpkin is coming tomorrow. At the very least, fall is the next consecutive season, so it kind of makes sense to start seeing some glimmers of cozy season ahead of the actual first day of autumn. Related: This Popular Ice Cream Brand is Launching a Mysterious New Collab and Fans Are Going Wild: 'Holy Moly' But we’re nowhere near winter and haven’t even started thinking about Christmas , so it’s a little disorienting for winter-themed items to start making their annual appearance. Sure, there’s some mixing between the middle of fall and winter, but Halloween hasn’t even happened yet! It’s giving “seasonal identity crisis,” and according to @markie_devo , the latest festive find from Coffee Mate is taking things even further. Just in time for the holidays—ehrm, well ahead of the holiday season, Coffee Mate just dropped new Frosted Gingerbread Cold Foam, and fans have thoughts. As delicious as it sounds, it feels more than a bit early with Christmas still being an entire four months away. The new cozy spiced coffee topper will be headed to Kroger stores soon, and if the flavor alone wasn’t enough to get you in the spirit of the holidays, it comes in a festive green color. The response from fans was mixed, with a few saying, “I love gingerbread !” and others saying the green coloring was throwing them off. “It feels like mint,” said one person, to which another agreed. Despite our hesitation, we will definitely be trying this festive holiday find—even if it is a bit early. If this is an early preview, we can’t wait to see what we get when we get closer to the actual holidays.
